# Fixtures

This directory is intentionally empty of sample trees.

`ctx`'s tests build their fixtures **programmatically** — each test creates a
throwaway tree with `tempfile::tempdir()` and writes exactly the files it needs
(see `write_file` / `write_bytes` in `tests/integration.rs`). That keeps every
test hermetic and self-describing: there is no checked-in tree to rot, no
generated bytes committed to git, and no fixture that only one test understands.

Two details make the tests immune to the machine they run on:

- `HOME`, `USERPROFILE` and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` are redirected into the temp
  directory, so a developer's global gitignore cannot change the result.
- Binary fixtures are written as raw bytes rather than text, so the binary
  detection rule is tested against real NUL bytes.
